objective: Introduce the fictional FF-17 and drive qualified visits to a fictional product-detail page while demonstrating natural product placement inside a small reading story.
audience: Adults who read during commutes, travel, or quiet evening routines; no health-condition targeting.

approved_facts.statement: Matte deep-moss body; cream silicone clip pad; one brass-tone circular hinge; narrow rectangular light head with six warm-white light apertures; USB-C port on the right side of the base when the logo faces the viewer; VELLUMVALE wordmark in cream on the outer clip arm; FF-17 model mark beneath the wordmark.

Rectangular deep-moss uncoated paper carton about 165 x 70 x 28 mm; horizontal cream belly band on the middle third; copper-foil VELLUMVALE wordmark centered on the front; cream line drawing of the folded light; crescent thumb notch at the top flap; FF-17 at lower right; no plastic window.

approved_claims.exact_wording: Up to 20 hours of light on the lowest setting.
Includes one FF-17 reading light and one 30 cm USB-C cable.

prohibited_depictions: Product cracked, scorched, submerged, wet, visibly unsafe, or intentionally damaged.
FF-17 used as a full-room lamp, flashlight for outdoor navigation, emergency beacon, toy, or wearable device.
USB-C port moved, controls added, hinge count changed, logo altered, or product recolored.
Obsolete version-1 packaging in an approved rendition.
Product beside a real branded book, device, package, logo, or recognizable copyrighted cover.
Any implication that the warm light treats a medical or sleep condition.

brand: Vellumvale Fixture Works is a wholly fictional, test-only brand.
Wordmark VELLUMVALE must be legible whenever the logo side faces camera at a readable scale.
style: Narrative role is a reading aid: attached to a book or folded beside a book.
Product proportions consistent with pinned reference images.
safety: No implication of medical or sleep treatment.
ip: No real branded book, device, package, logo, or recognizable copyrighted cover.
policy: Any panel using a product claim binds to the exact approved claim text and product snapshot version.
Packaging shown must be current version 2.

required_disclosures: #ad must appear in the first visible line of the caption and in any Story/Reel disclosure field supported by the channel adapter.
accessibility_requirements: Alt text must identify the product as a fictional clip-on reading light and must not introduce unapproved claims.
source_drift_behavior: On product, packaging, or claim change, Commerce Foundry emits a source-change event; Storyworld marks affected drafts, accepted assets, scheduled packages, and published instances stale and proposes revalidation, replacement, withdrawal, or documented waiver to the proper authority.
